name: Agency hero: an itemised price breakdown that totals itself, including the lines that cost nothing
notes: Signature effect: a price document on warm paper against a dark desk, whose rows arrive one at a time while their figures count up, so the total feels earned rather than asserted. The emotional payload is the second group, the lines that read $0: hosting, edits, answering the phone. Deliberate detail: countUp returns early on any zero, because a zero counting to zero is a fidget and the zeroes are the ones carrying the argument. Every amount is present in the markup as real text and the script only animates what is already there, so with JS off the correct figures show and a screen reader never hears a half-counted number. Line items sum to the stated total (600+150+50=800); if you change one, change the total. Tabular numerals plus a right-aligned column is what makes a price list look kept rather than typed. Part of the ten hero 940Digital brand series (sections 0027 to 0036); the series log, the contact sheet that renders all ten live, and the written recommendation are in brand-heroes/set-evidence/. Unlike the client-derived sections in this library, this one is NOT de-identified: 940Digital is Owen's own business, so there is no third party to protect and the real wordmark, palette and copy are the point of the section. Brand rules baked in across the whole series: display type at weight 500 with about -0.03em tracking (not 700); #3194E0 never carries text on a light background because it measures 2.90:1, so blue text on sand is #1F6FB0 and a blue fill takes a charcoal label at 5.18:1; every figure is JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums; text containers are sized in ch, not px.
